title: The rigid body: its G-matrix products with compile-time sizes, dispatched by the number of rotation coordinates
author: Claude-JG
description: CObjectRigidBody::ComputeODE2LHS and AddForceTorque multiply with G^T and Glocal^T of 3 x 3 or 3 x 4 by run-time sizes through checked access; templated on the number of rotation coordinates (3 or 4) and dispatched once per call, with the sums in the same order (docs/dev/design/linalgFixedSize.md section 5, point 4).
releaseNotes: not done: the templated G products of the rigid body are bitwise equal, but the rigid models change by -6 to +2 %, within the noise; the change was not kept
